draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in its training annotations: its mean test F1 drops by at most 2.0 points at all evaluated noise rates (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points at 10%, 20% and 30% label noise, respectively) on the Corvane-News NER test set.
rationale: T2 shows Thornbill-NER drops 0.6/1.3/1.8 points at 10/20/30% noise, all within the pre-specified 2.0-point robustness criterion. The sentence hedges with "appears somewhat" though the evidence supports an unqualified robustness claim within the evaluated scope.
